d:
What begins as a simple roommate arrangement slowly develops into something much more complicated as Marin introduces Gojo to the world of fashion, cosplay, and feminine presentation. This series will have a slow-burn HRT/MtF transgender transformation, exploring Gojo's changing appearance, identity, and relationship with Marin one step at a time.

This comic is intended as a successor/spiritual follow-up to Moonlly's Forever Summer, with a similar focus on gradual transformation, romance, and slice-of-life storytelling, while following a completely new story and cast dynamic.

Made by AlyTG. All characters are 18+.

New Chapter every 3 weeks in https://e-hentai.org/uploader/thebasement334 / https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/128943891
